title: ScoredSignal
description: System 1 (scoring) -> scored-signals -> consumed by S3 gate intake (Task 09). signal_id is the dedup key. FLAT message, no envelope. additionalProperties is false, so a field name not listed here is DLQ'd, not ignored — producer and consumer must agree on the exact spelling.

strategy_key.description: optional human name, e.g. 'nnfx_backtrader'. Informational; the gate keys on strategy_id.

model_score.description: Gatekeeper probability, or NULL when the champion does not know this strategy and refused to score it (S1-NOTICE-2026-08-17 §5). NULL is 'unscored', never 'scored zero' — the gate branches on it at Layer P; it must never be coerced to a number.

threshold_applied.description: The score threshold the producer applied, or NULL when unscored.

scoring_status.description: Explicit scoring provenance. Optional: when absent it is derived from model_score (null => unscored).

selection_basis.description: How this strategy earned its place in the live map. 'qualified' cleared every gate by measurement; 'designated' means a human published it DESPITE failing one. Any other value — including absent — is unknown, and unknown is never permissive: Layer P rejects it. Deliberately NOT in 'required': a missing basis must produce an auditable REJECTED decision row, not a silent DLQ.

gate_failures.description: The gates a 'designated' strategy failed, e.g. ['OOS=46.35mo < 60mo']. Logged with the decision; not itself decided on.

granularity.description: 'D' and 'D1' both mean the daily bar and are normalised to 'D' at intake.

atr.description: ATR in price units on the signal's granularity
